category_edits.rationale: Reduce feed-forward intermediate width from 2*hidden_units to hidden_units across all four category models to test whether lower capacity improves generalization. Preserve GELU, bidirectional attention, pre-norm residual blocks, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this same model class, ensuring checkpoint shapes agree.

change_summary: Narrow BERT4Rec feed-forward layers consistently for training and prediction across all four datasets.
